classes.name: Εκλογή εκπροσώπων θρησκευτικών ομάδων
classes.name_en: Representatives of the Maronite, Armenian, and Latin religious groups
classes.note: Each group elects one representative by plurality on the day of the House general election, for the House's term; the representatives sit in the House without a vote. Before 1965 the groups voted in the Greek Communal Chamber (art. 109).
classes.disposition_reason: The Ministry of Interior results site has no election type for the religious groups' representatives, and no other official publication of their results was found online.

classes.note: Each community elected its own Communal Chamber (art. 86) in 1960. Law 12/1965 dissolved the Greek Communal Chamber and moved its legislative powers to the House and its administration to a Ministry of Education; the Turkish Communal Chamber continued only outside the Republic's institutions.
classes.locator: https://www.cylaw.org/nomoi/arith/1965_1_012.pdf («ή Συνέλευσις… θεωρούνται ώς παύσασαι λειτουργούσαι… πασαι αϊ έδραι των μελών αυτής θεωρούνται ώς κενωθεΐσαι»); art. 86 of the Constitution establishes the chambers

dates.note: The only election of the chambers under the Republic.

classes.name: Εκλογές στις κατεχόμενες περιοχές
classes.name_en: Elections held by the authorities in the area not under the Republic's control
classes.disposition_reason: Held by an administration the Republic does not recognize, in territory its laws call occupied («κατεχόμενα εδάφη»); they are not elections of the Republic and are not run or published by its election authority.
